title: After the Fluid: Subexponential Decay in AdS$_4$
summary: We study the late-time behaviour of nonlinear perturbations of Schwarzschild-AdS$_4$ black branes and show that real-analytic initial data generically enter a regime controlled by the large-$k$ tail of the quasinormal mode spectrum $\{ω_{k\,n}\}$. Using the asymptotic scaling $\mathrm{Im}\,ω_{k\,n} \sim k^{-1/5}$ of the planar AdS$_4$ black brane, we derive a universal prediction that boundary observables decay in a stretched-exponential manner, specifically as $\exp(-c\, t^{5/6})$ up to a mild polynomial prefactor.
